body.description: Old pinned child remains at a native Director pause during publication.
body.source:
id: parity_child
namespace: exomachina.kestra_parity
description: Old pinned child remains at a native Director pause during publication.
tasks:
  - id: director_wait
    type: io.kestra.plugin.core.flow.Pause
    onResume:
      - id: approved
        type: BOOL
        defaults: false
  - id: old_result
    type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
    format: child-v1
outputs:
  - id: public_result
    type: STRING
    value: "{{ outputs.old_result.value }}"
